source.author: verg
source.text: Exstinxti te meque, soror, populumque patresque Sidonios urbemque tuam.
source.text_original: Exstinxti te meque, soror, populumque patresque / Sidonios urbemque tuam.
source.text_english: You have extinguished yourself and me too, sister, and the Sidonian people and fathers and your city.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: populumne levem veterique tyranno infensum atque olim miserantes Aesona patres advocet?
reuse.text_original: populumne levem veterique tyranno / infensum atque olim miserantes Aesona patres / advocet?
reuse.text_english: Should he summon a fickle people, hostile to the old tyrant, and the fathers of Aeson, who long ago had pity?
